=== v2.2.1
### Fixed
- **A response cut off by `max_tokens` no longer ends the run** (#35, fixed in #36). When the model stops because it reached `model_max_tokens` without calling a tool, pi continues: up to 3 cut-offs in a row (the count resets when a continuation uses tools), and never past `timeout`. Partial text from a cut-off response is posted and marked as cut off. Past the limit, pi posts an error with the partial text and suggests raising `model_max_tokens`.
- **The action no longer installs git hooks in the target repository** (#38, fixed in #41). Before this fix, pi-action installed its own `commit-msg` hook (pi-action's Conventional Commit types) and `prepare-commit-msg` hook (appends `Refs #<n>`) in every repository it ran in. That rejected commits that follow other conventions, such as `release: v0.35.1`. pi now follows the repository's own conventions. If your repository wants a commit format, enforce it yourself, for example with your own hooks, a CI check, or `AGENTS.md` / `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

### New
- **How to read the thread, in the workflow log** (#37): when a run works on a stored thread (`refs/pi/threads/<n>`), the log gets a collapsible group with the `git fetch` / `git log` / `git show` commands that read it. The job summary gets the same commands. This also happens when the run fails, times out, or ends on a question.

### Docs
- The README is now a landing page, with focused pages under [`docs/`](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/tree/v2.2.1/docs) (inputs, workflows, models, extensions, prompts, threads, security, how it works). Each claim was checked against the code (#34). `examples/prompt-templates.md` moved into `docs/prompts.md`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.2.0...v2.2.1

=== v2.2.2
### Fixed
- **pi no longer posts its reply twice** (#42, fixed in #43). In `output_mode: comment`, pi-action posts pi's final response as a comment, but nothing told pi this. With a token that can comment (`GH_TOKEN`), pi sometimes posted its reply itself with `gh issue comment`, and then pi-action posted it again. The built-in first message now has a `## Your Reply` section that tells pi not to post its reply with `gh`. Each follow-up and answer ends with a one-line reminder, so threads that began before this release get it too. Output mode and direct prompts are unchanged. A custom `prompt_template` is still the complete first message, but its follow-ups get the reminder. See [The reply](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.2.2/docs/prompts.md).

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.2.1...v2.2.2

=== v2.3.0

### Added
- **Working-tree continuity** (#33, added in #44). A thread now keeps the files that pi leaves uncommitted, staged and unstaged, on `refs/pi/worktrees/<number>`, and restores them at the start of the next run. When you rewind or fork the conversation, the files rewind too. Two new inputs: `worktree_snapshots` (default `true`) and `worktree_snapshot_exclude`. See [Working-tree continuity](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#working-tree-continuity).
- **A workflow log that shows what pi does** (#46, added in #48, #49, and #50). The log shows one line for each step while pi works: `💬` for the text of the model, `🔧` when a tool call starts, and `↳ ✓` or `↳ ✗ failed` when it ends. Click a `↳` line to see the arguments of the call and the last 30 lines of its output. Each reply gets a `✅ Replied` line with the comment and totals: model responses, tool calls, time, and tokens. The setup is in a collapsed `Setup` group. The thread, with the git commands that read it, is now at the start of the log. Pushes and working-tree snapshots are debug messages: to see them, enable step debug logging. See [The workflow log](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/how-it-works.md#the-workflow-log).

### Fixed
- **A fetch by pi no longer breaks the run** (#46, fixed in #47). If pi fetched into `refs/pi/*`, for example with `git fetch origin '+refs/pi/*:refs/pi/*'`, it moved the ref that the run was writing to. The session then failed without a reply, a reaction, or a failed step. A run now keeps its refs on `refs/pi-action/*` on the runner, and pushes them to `refs/pi/*` on the remote. See [Protection against conflicts](https://github.com/cv/pi-action/blob/v2.3.0/docs/threads.md#protection-against-conflicts).
- **A failed session is reported** (#46, fixed in #47). If the storage of the thread fails, pi-action posts a `❌ pi Error` comment with the cause, adds 😕 to the request, and fails the step.
- **No false warning from `Save pi thread state`** (#46, fixed in #47). If the remote already has the local commits, the step writes `already saved` to the log, not a warning.


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cv/pi-action/compare/v2.2.2...v2.3.0
